title: Slowest Wins
summary: Jackie challenges you to a reversed race through the Northside back roads, where the slowest car to the finish wins.
description: Jackie challenges V to a reversed race through the Northside back roads, where the slowest car to the finish wins. He says he will beat V at going slow.

start.bringUp: Jackie invites you to a race on the Northside back roads, but backwards. The slowest car to the finish wins, and he says he will beat you at going slow.

start.name: the start line on a Northside back road

finish.name: the finish line on a Northside waterfront lot

g1.asks: Rules are simple. But tell me, hermano, who's the better slow driver, you or me?
g1.know: The rules: the slowest car to the finish wins, there is no stopping, and nobody can stand still for more than 5 seconds. The route runs through the Northside back roads to a waterfront lot.

stages.label: The reversed race through Northside
stages.objective: Race Jackie to the Northside finish line, slowest car wins
stages.know: The race is on. Jackie rides his bike and waves at strangers, and he speeds up whenever he sees a food truck.
stages.wants: V to drive slowly and win.

win.memory: You and Jackie raced the Northside back roads at a crawl, and you were the slower car to the finish and won.

finish.memory: You and Jackie raced the Northside back roads at a crawl, and you both made it to the finish line.

unfinished.memory: You and Jackie were doing something light, and it ended there.

variations.know: Empty Northside roads at night, with nobody to race but each other.
A rain run on the Northside back roads, with bright headlights and slick tires.
A crowd of pedestrians at a crossing on the route, and Jackie waving at all of them.
